description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests designed to verify the integration and error handling of Git with Perforce (P4). It sources an external library script 'lib-git-p4.sh' and defines multiple test cases related to starting a P4 daemon, adding files, submitting changes, cloning repositories, and handling authentication errors.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server daemon for testing purposes.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds a file to Perforce version control.

methods.name: p4 passwd
methods.description: Changes the password for the current Perforce user.

methods.name: p4 login
methods.description: Logs a user into Perforce to obtain tickets.

methods.name: p4 logout
methods.description: Logs a user out of Perforce, invalidating tickets.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that is expected to fail, used for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit in the Git repository.
